cards.ruleTextEn: Bonus: +7 for each Weapon and/or Army in the discard area
Undead may not be BLANKED. Bonus: +10 for Necromancer and/or each other Undead
Bonus: +6 for each Wizard, Artifact and/or Outsider in the discard area
Bonus: +4 for each Wizard, Leader, Army, Beast and/or Undead in the discard area
Bonus: +5 for each Land, Flood, Flame, Weather and/or Unicorn in the discard area
Penalty: For each non-Outsider card: if it is the only card of its suit in your hand, it is BLANKED. This happens before any other blanking
Bonus: At the end of the game, draw the top card of the deck and add it to your hand (before the Genie)
Bonus: This card can never be BLANKED. Protects any one other card from being BLANKED
Bonus: +10 for each card with a Penalty that is not CLEARED
Bonus: +10 for each opponent. At the end of the game you may search the deck and add one card to your hand (after the Leprechaun)
Bonus: +11 for each Leader and/or Beast. Penalty: BLANKED with any Undead, Necromancer and/or Demon
Bonus: +40 if you have exactly two cards among the following suits: Leader, Wizard, Outsider and Undead
Bonus: The sum of the base strength of all Undead in hand. Penalty: BLANKS all Leaders
Bonus: +10 for the first Leader, Army, Land and other Building each. +5 for each additional Building
Bonus: +10 for the first Undead, Beast and Artifact each. +5 for each additional card of these suits and for Necromancer, Warlock, Demon
May duplicate the name and suit of any Army, Building, Land, Weather, Flood or Flame in the game. Does not take the bonus, penalty or base strength of the card duplicated
May duplicate the name and suit of any Artifact, Leader, Wizard, Weapon, Beast or Undead in the game. Does not take the bonus, penalty or base strength of the card duplicated
Bonus: +70 if every non-BLANKED card is a different suit
Bonus: At the end of the game, you may take one Army, Leader, Wizard, Beast or Undead from the discard area and add it to your hand. Undead may not be BLANKED
Bonus: +10 for each Land and Building; Clears the word Army from the Penalty section of all cards in hand
Penalty: BLANKS all Armies, all Buildings, all Lands except Mountain, and all Flames except Lightning
Bonus: Add the base strength of any one Weapon, Building, Flood, Flame, Land or Weather in your hand
Bonus: +15 with any one Wizard or Undead
